verdict.info: No 3yo has won this race since 2001 so history is against both \bThread Of Gold\p and \bMr Vettori\p. \bImmutable\p ran a fine race in the Cork Derby last time but would prefer softer ground than this, so a tentative vote goes to \bTHIS SONGISFORYOU\p. He's well drawn, has previous at this festival, and his latest run at the Curragh was a step in the right direction. \bThe Real Screamer\p wasn't far behind the selection last time and can go well too if behaving himself in the stalls. \bFixation\p and \bSatono Chevalier\p complete the shortlist. [Dave Stephens]
